# Manka Farms
> Registered Farmstay by MP Tourism: a private jungle farmhouse near Pench Tiger Reserve, Amajhiri, Kurai 480881, Madhya Pradesh, India.

- 4 bedrooms, 5 bathrooms, sleeps up to 20
- ~7 km from Turia Gate (Pench Tiger Reserve), ~1 km from Pench buffer zone
- On-site EV charging (11 kW), bonfire evenings, pot-making experience, caretaker on-site
- Website: https://mankafarms.in/
